name: Planning checklist
description: A lightweight personal planning checklist with local checkboxes and a progress summary.
whenToUse: A short disposable checklist or planning aid that does not need shared database records.
whenNotToUse: Persistent task tracking, regulated sign-off, audit evidence or approvals; use a database-backed tracker for these.
instructions: Read read_app_template_guidance(resource:"usage") and this template's documentation before preparation. Provide items as newline-separated text. Checkmarks are local session state only. Explain this limitation; choose the Vivid tracker if the user needs saved progress. Configuration is available in templateConfiguration. This template cannot grant approval or write to the database.

defaults.heading: Planning checklist
defaults.items:
Define the objective
Agree the next steps
Review the plan

items.description: One checklist item per line, up to 30 items

examples.heading: Meeting preparation
examples.items:
Review agenda
Gather questions
Confirm attendees

quickStart: Supply a heading and up to 30 newline-separated checklist items.
Prepare without database bindings and verify progress behavior. Choose a persistent tracker instead when checkmarks must be shared or saved.
documentation.dataContract: No database tables or record writes. Checkbox state and progress are local session state and may reset when reopened.
documentation.interactionContract: Labeled checkboxes submit Update progress and display a checked/total summary. Escape configured item text; do not treat checkmarks as audited approvals.
documentation.lifecycle: Keep the same app ID for revisions. Use one requestKey for creation retries and verify its save receipt. The first-save prompt applies only to a new unsaved app. Loading failures retain the last usable view; publication never forces a reload. Local inputs are not committed records.
limitations: No saved progress, shared tasks, regulated sign-off or audit evidence. Use a database-backed tracker when these are needed.

examples.expectedBehavior: A local checklist that clearly states its progress is not saved.

tasks.whenUseful: No task is needed for this on-demand local tool. Consider a separate connected app only if the user requests recurring research or reporting.
tasks.outputContract: No scheduled writes, emails or notifications.
tasks.promptExample: Do not create a task for this template by default. If requirements change, first define a saved data/output destination and use the generic monitoring guide.
